sentences.japanese: 学生全員が劇に参加しています。
sentences.english: All the students will partake in the play.

sentences.japanese: 我々のクラスが劇を上演した時、私は舞台効果を受け持った。
sentences.english: When our class performed a play, I took charge of stage effects.

sentences.japanese: 公園で劇の台詞を覚えなければならなかった。
sentences.english: We had to memorize the lines of the play in the park.

sentences.japanese: メアリーはその劇で老婆の役を演じた。
sentences.english: Mary played the role of an old woman in the play.

sentences.japanese: どんな俳優も劇が始まる前にはびくびくするものだ。
sentences.english: Every actor has cold feet just before the beginning of a show.
